location: Ireland, County Down, Bangor, Belfast Lough, opposite Carrickfergus
description: A monastic settlement traditionally founded by St.Comgall where he died in the late 6th CE or early 7th CE. Excavations in the area have not yet revealed the earliest abbey, but did reveal a wood lined gully dated by radiocarbon dating to the 6th CE, and is thought to be associated with the earliest monastic activity.
